h1: B2B Lead Generation Company in Kolkata
intro: Myntmore is a B2B lead generation company for Kolkata's healthcare suppliers, engineering and steel firms, trading houses and IT companies. Our lead generation services in Kolkata use cold email, LinkedIn outreach and ABM to reach business buyers such as procurement heads, distributors and operations leaders. We do not generate patient leads for hospitals or clinics.

why.title: Decades of trading relationships, no way to grow past them
why.desc: Kolkata's legacy trading houses, and its long-standing strength in jute, steel, and engineering, have grown on networks built over generations. That's a strong foundation, but it caps growth once every existing relationship has been tapped.

why.title: An IT sector competing against better-funded rivals
why.desc: Kolkata's growing IT and ITES companies are up against far larger tech hubs like Bengaluru and Pune for the same buyers. Winning that fight needs a sharper, more systematic outbound motion, not more cold calls.

why.title: Financial services with deep history, thin digital pipeline
why.desc: The city's long-established financial services base has real credibility, but much of its new-business generation still depends on personal networks rather than a repeatable outbound system.
